title: The nonpositive-degree contraction equation on a head-tail summand
statement: For every commutative ring A, natural r,m, coefficient list a : Fin(r+1) to A and integers p,q with p ≤ 0 and q ≤ 0, the explicit multiplication map of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-join-graded] from the tensor summand (p,q) to degree p+q of completedKoszulPower(r+1,a,m) intertwines the outgoing differential with the sum of head contraction and tail contraction multiplied by the cochain tensor sign epsilon_2(p,q).

source.place: Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex, proof hint: exterior generators of the two factors and their Koszul differentials.

proof.text: Use the extension isomorphism followed by the exterior-power inclusion as an injective coordinate map. On a pure tensor, the explicit summand map becomes the product of the head and tail exterior images. Naturality of contraction under each inclusion follows by left induction and equality of the pulled-back coefficient linear forms.

Mathlib extend_d_eq conjugates the differential between consecutive nonpositive degrees to koszulBoundary, whose inclusion into the exterior algebra is contraction. If a factor has exterior degree zero, its contraction is zero: use zeroEquiv and contraction of algebraMap. Its outgoing summand in positive cochain degree is also zero by definition. This identifies both head and tail contributions, including their boundary cases.

When p+q=0, both p and q are zero and every outgoing differential vanishes by extension by zero. Otherwise put n=-p, k=-q and s=-(p+q+1). Evaluate the morphism equation on pure tensors and apply the injective exterior coordinate in degree s. Use the graded contraction Leibniz identity and identify the scalar action of epsilon_2(p,q) with multiplication by algebraMap((-1)^n), using negOnePow_neg and cast_negOnePow_natCast. Tensor-product extensionality finishes the equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0622 and 0664, definition-koszul and lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex; T4 supplies the extension-coordinate transport and degree-zero cases.

theorem koszulJoinSummand_leibniz_nonpositive
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (m : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hp : p ≤ 0) (hq : q ≤ 0) :
    koszulJoinSummand (A := A) r a m p q (p + q) rfl ≫
        (completedKoszulPower (A := A) (r + 1) a m).d (p + q) (p + q + 1) =
      ((completedKoszulPower (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m).d p (p + 1) ⊗ₘ 𝟙 _) ≫
          koszulJoinSummand r a m (p + 1) q (p + q + 1) (by omega) +
        ComplexShape.ε₂ (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (p, q) •
          ((𝟙 _ ⊗ₘ
            (completedKoszulPower (A := A) r (fun j ↦ a j.succ) m).d q (q + 1)) ≫
              koszulJoinSummand r a m p (q + 1) (p + q + 1) (by omega))
